==Overview==
===Format===
*'''Group Stage'''
** Double Round-Robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** 1st place gets seeded to the Finals
** 2nd place gets seeded to the Semifinals
*** 3rd and 4th qualify to the Playoffs
*** 5th, 6th and 7th retain their league spot for the [[LMS/2019/Summer|Summer 2019]]
*** Last place team plays in the [[LMS/2019/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion]]
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2019|Mid-Season Invitational 2019]].
